integrity: The statements have an explicit all-exponent proof and a runnable standard-library checker; finite verification does not certify infinite quantifiers; external independent examination has not been performed.

scope_description: All target fibers of the monic cubic Dickson polynomial modulo every positive power of two, with sharp maxima and number of maximizing residues.
title: Exact dyadic fiber law for the cubic Dickson polynomial
